Standalone DOCX extraction using extract

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"filename":"fake.docx","kind":"uri","mime_type":"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document","uri":"https://example.com/docx/fake.docx"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
